topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: The rain doesn't stop, just like the clatter of my typewriter as I pound out this note. Got word from a kid, fresh out of school, thinking he's made a big play. Turned out, his college essay, his words, his heart and soul, ended up splashed across some website as a model. Now, he's looking to me to find out who reached in and lifted his story. Thing is, in this city, everybody’s got an angle, and nobody gives away their secrets for free. I just hope this kid’s got enough left in him to stay quiet until the truth can breathe.
